name: RoutingOperationsEditor
tagline: Edit manufacturing routings and see lead time, bottleneck and cost per unit instantly.
description: An advanced PCF control for process engineers: operations with work centres, setup and run times, alternates, overlap and subcontract steps; a lead-time Gantt, cost roll-up, work centre load, lot-size sensitivity and a revision approval workflow. Works in Canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Operation editor with insert, duplicate, move, renumber and undo
Work centres with efficiency, rates, queue and move defaults
Alternate work centres with what-if switching
Lead-time Gantt with queue/setup/run/move and send-ahead overlap
Cost roll-up, work centre load and lot-size sensitivity
Draft → review → approved → new revision workflow
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
